headline: Keysight EDA internship explores AI schematic generation for RFIC and analog design
fact: Keysight advertised EDA AI/ML Software Intern role 54582 in Calabasas, with retained listings dated September 29. The MS/PhD internship explores AI applications in RFIC/analog schematic generation alongside layout automation, device modeling and design optimization. Responsibilities include Python ML prototypes, training/evaluation pipelines and integration into desktop software. Schematic-generation exploration is the qualifying design task; the advertisement does not establish topology invention, autonomous circuit synthesis or signoff-quality generated designs.
